messages.en:
{07 15 00}Hey!{01 00 00 05 00} Kid!{01 00 00 0f 00} You and me made
plans for me to come over,
remember? REMEMBER?
{07 05 00}WHERE WERE YOU?{01 01 00}
{07 00 00}I got there with bells on,
and no one was home!
Aw, when somethin' like this
happens{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0f 00}it just brings
me down, {04 02 00}.{03 03 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Hei!{01 00 00 05 00} Poiss!{01 00 00 0f 00} Me leppisime
kokku, et ma tulen külla,
mäletad? MÄLETAD?
{07 05 00}KUS SA OLID?{01 01 00}
{07 00 00}Ma tulin ilusti kohale,
ja kedagi polnud kodus!
Ah, kui midagi sellist
juhtub{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0f 00}see teeb mind
kurvaks, {04 02 00}.{03 03 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}{07 01 00}Why do
you gotta treat people like
that, huh?
{07 16 00}I was looking forward to
hanging out at your house,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!!
{07 05 00}And then you weren't there!{01 01 00}
You're nothin' but a CHUMP,
{04 1f 00}!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 00 00}{07 01 00}Miks sa
pead inimesi niimoodi
kohtlema, mis?
{07 16 00}Ma ootasin, et saaksin
sinu majas aega veeta,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!!
{07 05 00}Ja siis sind polnudki seal!{01 01 00}
Sa pole muud kui TOLA,
{04 1f 00}!{03 02 00 01}
